name: gizza-ai/key-derive
summary: Derive a key of any length via PBKDF2, scrypt, Argon2, or HKDF

tool.description: One unified key-derivation-function selector: derive a raw key of a chosen byte length from a passphrase or seed via PBKDF2, scrypt, Argon2id/i/d, or HKDF (RFC 5869). Pick `algorithm` (default pbkdf2) and its own parameters — pbkdf2: hash + iterations; scrypt: n/r/p; argon2: memory_kib/time_cost/parallelism + argon2_variant (returns RAW chosen-length key material, not a PHC hash); hkdf: hash + info (for high-entropy seeds/keys, not passwords). `secret` and `salt` accept utf8/hex/base64 encodings; output is hex (default) or base64. Deterministic and runs locally — the secret never leaves the device.

algorithm.description: Key-derivation function: pbkdf2 (default), scrypt, argon2 (raw Argon2id/i/d key material), or hkdf (RFC 5869, for high-entropy seeds/keys — not passwords).

encoding.description: Output encoding of the derived key (default hex).

hash.description: Underlying hash for pbkdf2 (sha1/256/384/512) and hkdf (default sha256).

info.description: HKDF context/application info string (hkdf only; optional).

info_encoding.description: How `info` is encoded (hkdf only; default utf8).

memory_kib.description: Argon2 memory cost in KiB (argon2 only; default 19456 = 19 MiB).

n.description: scrypt CPU/memory cost N, a power of two > 1 (scrypt only; default 16384).

r.description: scrypt block size r (scrypt only; default 8).

salt.description: Salt (recommended; required for argon2, min 8 bytes). HKDF treats an empty salt as all-zeros per RFC 5869.

secret.description: The passphrase or input key material to derive from.
